svg.aria-label: One repo for the family: It holds the CI, the lint configs and the templates for the whole synthwerk family. Thin callers: The caller workflow stays at about 10 lines. The job matrix lives here. Docs or no merge: A PR that changes feature source without its feature doc fails the check. The checker has zero dependencies. Strict by default: Every run step runs bash -euo pipefail. Every job gets contents: read only
